definitions.gloss: bad feeling; ill will; antipathy; dislike
definitions.explanation: A negative feeling or impression toward someone or something. A sense of hostility, dislike, or aversion.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{態度|たいど}に{悪感|あくかん}を{持|も}った。
examples.english: I felt antipathy toward his attitude.

examples.japanese: {悪感|あくかん}を{与|あた}えないように{丁寧|ていねい}に{断|ことわ}った。
examples.english: I refused politely so as not to give a bad impression.

notes:
Composed of {悪|あく} (bad, evil) and {感|かん} (feeling). Refers to a negative feeling directed toward someone or something. Often interchangeable with {悪感情|あくかんじょう}, which is more explicit.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {悪感|あくかん}を{抱|いだ}く: to harbor ill will
- {悪感|あくかん}を{持|も}つ: to have a bad feeling
- {悪感|あくかん}を{与|あた}える: to give a bad impression

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {悪感情|あくかんじょう}: ill feeling, animosity — a fuller, more explicit form
- {反感|はんかん}: antipathy, hostility — stronger sense of opposition or resistance
- {嫌悪感|けんおかん}: disgust, revulsion — a stronger, more visceral negative feeling
- {好感|こうかん}: favorable impression — the opposite of {悪感|あくかん}
